hook: New federal tax corrections will catch employers off guard on Form W-2.

sections.voiceover: New federal tax corrections will catch employers off guard on Form W-2.
b_roll: Close up of IRS tax form on an office desk

sections.voiceover: On October 1, 2026, Connecticut enforced new pay transparency amendments. Will your dependent care reporting pass the $5000 exclusion limit?
Worse, the Internal Revenue Service requires employer payments for leave to count as wages.

Paycom published the State of Compliance October 2026 report detailing these exact rules. Companies face strict audits for failing to report employee and employer payments correctly. Federal tax forms W-2 and W-3 demand exact compliance.
b_roll: Completed tax form W-2 and W-3

sections.voiceover: Form W-2 reporting changes take effect immediately.
